title: OceanBench v2 catalog
description: catalog.json at the artifact root (contracts.md §5). Generated by the publish stage, never hand-edited. Indexes the single scores.parquet plus, per release / year / region / challenger, the insight manifest and viewer zarr URLs.

schema_version.description: Catalog contract version. 2.0 for the v2 pipeline.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which publish produced this catalog.

scores_url.description: URL of the single compacted scores.parquet for the whole benchmark.

challengers_url.description: Optional URL of the challengers.json registry copy stamped at publish time (contracts.md §8).

releases.description: Map of release version (semver string, e.g. "2.0.0") to the years it covers.

years.description: Map of evaluation year (string, e.g. "2024") to its regions.

regions.description: Map of region id (contracts.md §2: global, ibi, gulfstream, kuroshio) to its challengers.

region.description: Map of challenger registry slug to its per-region artifact URLs.

insights_manifest_url.description: URL of this challenger's insights/manifest.json for the release/year/region.

viewer_zarr_url.description: URL of this challenger's viewer zarr pyramid for the year.
